svg.text: Breaking the cubic symmetry changes the critical picture
Same square window, same Newton budget. The only change is the polynomial.
roots ○, critical points ×, same square window
roots ○, critical points ×, same square window
The unity cubic is hottest right on top of its repeated center
critical point. The asymmetric cubic spreads that tension out
Dominant basin share by critical distance
Symmetry breaking does not just move the critical set. It also
lets one root own much more of the sampled square.
